name: VideoUpload
summary: Production board for YouTube teams: scripts, edits, timestamped video review and publishing to YouTube in one place, with editor payment tracking. One price per workspace; editors join free.
best_for: YouTube creators and small production teams that juggle editors, scripts and review over spreadsheets and chat, and want one board from idea to scheduled upload
skip_if: you publish mainly outside YouTube, work alone without editors, or already run review and approval in a general project tool you are happy with
honest_knock: It is built for YouTube only: publishing and channel stats go to YouTube, not to other platforms. If you stop paying, uploaded video files are deleted after 30 days (boards, notes and comments are kept). The pricing page shows yearly per-month prices on the cards and monthly prices in the table, so read both. AI writing uses credits that reset monthly; extra credits are a paid top-up.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Creator · Creator billed monthly: you + 2 team members, 1 channel, 50 GB, 100 AI credits a month
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-03 on videoupload.team/pricing) VideoUpload charges one flat price per workspace, with no per-seat fees: only the workspace owner pays, and editors, scriptwriters and designers join free within the plan's team limit. Creator costs $25 a month, or $240 billed yearly ($20 a month), for you plus 2 team members, 1 channel, 50 GB of storage, 2 GB per upload and 100 AI credits a month. Studio costs $59 a month, or $564 a year ($47 a month), for you plus 5, up to 5 channels, 500 GB, client review links, editor payment tracking and API and Claude (MCP) access. Agency costs $149 a month, or $1,428 a year ($119 a month), for you plus 30, unlimited channels, 5 client workspaces, 2 TB and priority support. The plan cards show the yearly price per month ($20, $47, $119); the comparison table shows the monthly prices. On 3 November a founding-member offer gave 50% off the first 3 months on monthly plans, with today's price locked in. Every account starts with a 14-day trial of Studio features (you + 5, 10 GB) without a card, and a full refund is available within 14 days of the first payment.
